This FloPlast 110mm 135° push-fit single socket bend is a robust uPVC pipe fitting for soil and vent drainage systems. Ideal for creating directional changes in plumbing configurations, it offers strength and durability, ensuring long-term performance. The black uPVC construction is suitable for high-temperature waste discharges. Featuring a push-fit connection and reliable ring seal joints, this lightweight bend allows for quick, secure, and watertight installation for plumbers and builders. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
